title: [Linux] Display server and Renderer support HDR, but window doesn't when Wayland display brightness is 100%
body:
### Tested versions

v4.7.stable.arch_linux [5b4e0cb0f]

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable (5b4e0cb0f) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu, 16 Jul 2026 17:41:28 +0000 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 (nvidia; 610.43.03) - AMD Ryzen 9 5900X 12-Core Processor (24 threads) - 62.69 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

I have been unable to get HDR to work properly under KDE Plasma in Arch Linux for a few hours. I followed the steps outlined in the [hdr_output tutorial ](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/tutorials/rendering/hdr_output.html), exported the hdr sample project for both windows and linux (dual booting), and only the one for windows works successfully. On my linux boot, hdr does not seem to be enabled in editor or when running the project. I've verified hdr works and is enabled elsewhere (Blender, hdr video in mpv, kscreen-doctor, etc.). Happy to help troubleshoot further!

### Steps to reproduce

Follow the  [hdr_output tutorial ](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/latest/tutorials/rendering/hdr_output.html)
Run project from editor or export and run standalone.

N/A
